messages:
Zoe: Mystery muffins showed up in the kitchen this morning with a sticky note: 'for the late shift, enjoy :)' Whoever left them, you are a legend. :brown_heart:
Marcus: That was me! Was trying to cheer up the paging team after last night's oncall storm. Glad they landed well. :chef:
Lina: omg bless you Marcus. They were gone in 12 minutes. Also helped my afternoon slump. :sparkles:
Priya: Huge thanks to Marcus from the SRE crew. He fixed the noisy disk queue at 3am and still managed to bake? Respect. :raised_hands:
DevOpsBot: Incident note: disk-queue spike mitigated by @Marcus at 03:12 UTC. Auto-acknowledged by alerting system.
Ava: Can we add a tiny kudos to Marcus on the kudos board? Maybe a 'Baker + Band-Aid' badge. :medal:
Zoe: Done — added a kudos and a cheeky comment: "saved our metrics *and* our tastebuds". :laughing:
Marcus: lol please no tiny trophy collection. Happy to help. If anyone wants the recipe (very simple muffin hack), DM me.
Lina: Quick poll: bring-your-own-muffin next Friday? React :thumbsup: for yes, :shrug: for maybe.
Priya: :thumbsup: I'm in. Also leaving a big virtual high-five for Marcus again.
DevOpsBot: Poll created: "BYOM Friday" (expires in 5 days).
Ava: Photos? I snagged one before they disappeared, posted to #random-media.
